items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee is Charlie Barnet. The mention of Valerie Wilmer is made by the Interviewer, not the Interviewee. The Interviewee does not respond to or acknowledge Valerie Wilmer in the provided text.

ctx.x: In Valerie Wilmer's book, (Interruption in recording,) -- she says Babs Gonzalez's first name job was with Charlie Barnet in 1944. "He toured with alto saxophonist's big band for several weeks, but never recorded, mainly because

Lena Horne was then the featured attraction. Never one to pass up an opportunity for blowing his own metaphorical trumpet, Babs could not resist commenting, 'My job was more or less to help Lena out vocally. She's a great lady, but during that time I probably didn't hit the floor over seven times in maybe nine weeks, because I was down in the hall, rehearsing Lena'.
